pricing.details: Free 0 € per user/month — unlimited projects, 1 workspace, 1 cloud provider, 1 apply per project, community support on Slack, no card. Team 44 € per user/month, or 443 € per user/year (37 €/month, 2 months free) — 2 workspaces included, unlimited applies, email support with a standard SLA. Each applied workspace beyond the first two costs 45 €/month. Enterprise custom (unlimited workspaces, SSO, audit trail, dedicated support).
pricing.label: Freemium
